newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Pekao SA to raise credit, cut deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Polish Pekao SA to raise credit, cut deposit rates.

text.p: The Polish state-owned Pekao SA bank said it would raise the base zloty credit rate by 0.5 point to 25 percent and cut interest on zloty deposits by between one and two points on February 14.
After the cut, the average interest on zloty deposits would drop to eight percent from 10 percent.
On February 15, Pekao SA will cut interest on call dollar and mark deposits by 0.25 point to 2.25 percent and 1.75 percent respectively and by 0.2 point on six-month mark deposits to 2.60 percent. @
However, Pekao SA will raise interest on six-month dollar depos by 0.2 point to four percent.

The move follows a decision by the National Bank of Poland to raise banks' obligatory reserves on February 28 by three points to 20 percent for zloty call deposits and two points to four percent for all currency deposits.
